integrity.methods: Exhaustive residue-mask recursion plus independent direct subset checks

scientific_limitations: The exact classification concerns modulus six and the corresponding residue classes modulo thirty-six only.
The general conjecture s_1(n)=2n+1 is not proved here for other n.
The finite enumeration is reproducible from complete source code and a canonical certificate, not from random sampling.
A complete independent literature priority check has not been carried out.
title: Exact six-term zero-sum threshold and extremal profiles modulo \(36\)
